source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, a few seconds into the script: Ben stands on the grey stone floor at the foot of the left shaft with Fizz 3 and Score 00000 in the translucent HUD box and two fzzt captions above him, and a small magenta puff sits where his shot hit the floor short of the spikes; plank ledges with yellow nosings and iron brackets climb the blue board wall, with the red brick pier and the dark stone on the right.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, a little before the middle of the script: Ben stands on a plank ledge and the chicken, at the ledge's left end, has its beak open with bwuk-BWUK floating above it in Fizz 1's pixel font.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, just after Ben took the red key: the key tray in the HUD box shows the red socket filled beside the empty blue one, Fizz reads 2, the chicken, stunned by Ben's shot, sits on the ledge beside him, and the captions red gumdrop and fzzt float above it.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox on the open-air gallery at night: Ben has fired all five Fizz shots (Fizz 0 and Deaths 1 in the HUD box) and a fzzt caption fades beside him; two soda cans stand in front of the snack shelf, which holds the blue key, a cookie, a snack bar and two more cans, and the green exit doorway and the shut blue door are on his left, with the railing, the sea and the headlands behind.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox on the pogo stick above the shelf, a moment after Ben took a soda can and a snack: the HUD box shows Fizz 5, the points of the snacks as +3 in the place of the word Score, and the score counting up to 00005 (the leading zeros dim), Deaths 1 and the two empty key sockets; the captions crunch, fsssht and boing float where they happened.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox on the pogo stick over the shelf, a moment after Ben took the blue key: the second socket of the HUD's key tray holds the blue key inside a white ring, with +8 above the score that is counting up to 00010, Fizz 5 and Deaths 1; the captions blue gumdrop, crunch and boing float over the shelf.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox on the gallery: Ben bounces on the pogo stick beside the right-hand wall and the caption boing (yellow) floats at the spot of the bounce, with Fizz 0, Score 00002 and Deaths 1 in the HUD box.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox at the end of the script: Ben has stepped off the pogo stick into the green exit doorway and pressed Up, with the caption ta-da! (light green) at the doorway, Fizz 5, Score 00010 and Deaths 1 in the HUD box and LEVEL CLEAR below.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox, keys typed through the X server: after a jump onto the first ledge Ben holds Up alone for 1.8 seconds, so he looks up and the view has risen to show the chicken, which has just clucked bwuk, bwuk.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox: Up and Space pressed together, so Ben raises the blaster and a shot rises above him, with the caption fzzt (Fizz 4 in the HUD box).

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import

source: FIZZ2.EXE /CHECKCELLS in DOSBox through tools/dosrun.sh, drawn by tools/render-cells.py
shows: The check screen of FIZZ2.EXE in DOSBox's default machine (VGA, a mouse, no joystick, no AdLib and no Sound Blaster, a 486 with an x87 and 14 MB free), drawn from the 80 by 25 text cells that FIZZ2.EXE /CHECKCELLS printed, by tools/render-cells.py with the machine's VGA console font: the PC speaker row is lit as the sound the game would use.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The transcript FIZZ2.EXE printed during the grabbed replay run.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /? in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The text of FIZZ2.EXE /? in DOSBox: the modes, the keys, the captions and the sound switches on one screen of 22 lines.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /PROBE in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The output of FIZZ2.EXE /PROBE in DOSBox's default machine: the PROBE lines for video, mouse, joystick, FM chip, Sound Blaster, BLASTER, x87, processor and free memory, then the CELLS hash, the SOUND line and the usual platform lines.
